repo_notes.content: CiviWave-FEM is a GPU-accelerated Finite Element Method (FEM) solver optimized for AMD integrated GPUs. Uses Vulkan 1.3 compute pipelines with Slang shaders, C++26/GCC 15.2, CMake 4.1.2. Source-first dependency policy via FetchContent. Key directories: src/ (core), include/cwf/ (headers), tests/ (Google Test), docs/ (guides). Physics: linear small-strain elasticity, implicit Newmark-β, matrix-free PCG solver.
repo_notes.author: LukeFrankio

repo_notes.content: CiviWave-FEM é um solucionador MEF acelerado por GPU para iGPUs AMD. Usa Vulkan 1.3 compute com shaders Slang, C++26/GCC 15.2, CMake 4.1.2. Política source-first via FetchContent. Diretórios: src/ (core), include/cwf/ (headers), tests/ (Google Test), docs/ (guias). Física: elasticidade linear pequenas deformações, Newmark-β implícito, PCG matrix-free.
repo_notes.author: LukeFrankio

repo_notes.content: ARCHITECTURE: YAML config → Gmsh mesh loading → CPU preprocessing (gradients, volumes, mass) → GPU buffer upload (SoA) → Newmark-β time stepping → PCG solve → post-processing (von Mises, VTU export). GPU uses VK_EXT_descriptor_buffer, timeline semaphores, wave64 subgroups for AMD RDNA.
repo_notes.author: LukeFrankio

repo_notes.content: ARQUITETURA: Config YAML → carregamento Gmsh → pré-processamento CPU (gradientes, volumes, massa) → upload GPU (SoA) → Newmark-β → PCG → pós-processamento (von Mises, VTU). GPU usa VK_EXT_descriptor_buffer, semáforos timeline, subgrupos wave64 para AMD RDNA.
repo_notes.author: LukeFrankio

repo_notes.content: SHADERS: src/shaders/ contains ke_apply_element.slang (strain→stress→forces), ke_gather_node.slang (nodal assembly), pcg_*.slang (CG solver), newmark_*.slang (time integration), derive_fields.slang (post-processing). Utilities: common.slang, reductions.slang, bc.slang.
repo_notes.author: LukeFrankio

repo_notes.content: PHYSICS: Linear elasticity ε=sym(∇u), σ=D:ε with 6×6 Voigt D-matrix. Rayleigh damping C=α·M+β·K. Newmark-β (β=0.25, γ=0.5), K_eff=K+(γ/βΔt)C+(1/βΔt²)M. PCG with block-Jacobi preconditioner, FP64 reductions, relative tolerance.
repo_notes.author: LukeFrankio
